title: Portland · Columbia Gorge and Mount Hood
slogan: Waterfalls, gorge wind and a mountain backdrop.
story: Waterfalls, gorge wind and a mountain backdrop. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 100 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Crown Point, Mount Hood Timberline, while Sandy return and Hood River food keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Historic Columbia River Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 24 km this is Historic Columbia River Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
